## About
Upper Deck is the neighborhood bar on N Harrison Ave in Cary. Come in for a beer, some wings and a game of darts, or just catch whatever's on one of our TVs.
We keep a rotating lineup on tap, run food and drink specials every day, and have a diverse menu for the foodies. Our wings are what we're known for.
Bring friends for pool, darts, indoor cornhole or ping pong. People rate us 4.4 stars across 597 Google reviews, and we'd love to see you here.

## Services
- Rotating beers on tap: 28 rotating beers on tap, so there's always something new to try.
- Wings: Our wings are what we're known for. We think they're the best wings in the Triangle.
- Daily food and drink specials: Something on special every day, for both food and drinks.
- Darts, pool, indoor cornhole and ping pong: 17 dart boards, pool tables, indoor cornhole and ping pong for you and your friends.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open every day from 12 PM to 2 AM, Monday through Sunday.

Q: Do you have non-alcoholic beer?
A: Yes. One reviewer mentioned we have a handful of NA beer options.

Q: Is there a cornhole night?
A: One reviewer mentioned cornhole on Thursday. Give us a call to check what's going on this week.

## What customers say
- "Had a good time here. Nice bar. Free darts and ping pong. They have pool tables and fooseball too.
The wings though... The wings, the wings, the wings! They are to die for. Some of the best wings I've ever had! We went twice. The bartender for lunch was much more friendlier than the night bartender, but overall, a great experience." (Antia Banner, 5/5)
- "Good spot for a late night bite and drinks. They have a handful of NA beer options and the food we had was delicious. The garbage plate was surprisingly good, despite the name!" (Spencer Williams, 5/5)
- "Great place for steel tip darts. Cornhole on Thursday.  The food was good and fast, great drink prices and specials." (Mike Pigg, 5/5)
- "25FEB24 Met some friends here for a quick bite. We split several menu items including boneless wings Nashville Hot, fish bites, tater tots and pretzel bites.
Everything seemed a little oily, I assume butter in the pretzels. The Nashville Hot Wing sauce was... different. Seemed to have a bit of a sweetness to it. Not terrible just not expected.
The service was great!
If I'm in the area again, I wouldn't hesitate to stop in." (David Randolph, 4/5)
- "Me and the wife been looking around for somwplace new to us and found this little gem of a place.  Very nice, relaxed atmosphere and good food.  Definitely will come back again." (Christopher West, 4/5)
